title: Why objects orbit or escape gravity explained visually
description: A clear visual look at how launch speed determines whether an object falls back, enters orbit, or escapes a planet forever.

shots.narration: Gravity pulls every object toward the center. Without enough sideways movement, the launched craft simply arcs upward and crashes back down.
With extra speed, the ground curves away just as fast as the craft drops. It falls constantly without ever hitting the surface.
At escape velocity, the craft moves too fast for gravity to stop it. The pull grows weaker, and it travels into deep space forever.
